name: app/data-table
title: DataTable
summary: A real <table> with a caption and scoped headers, that becomes one card per row on narrow screens so a phone never scrolls sideways. Cells are data, never markup; a cell can be a person (avatar, name, secondary line), and each row can carry its own actions (links or small forms) that work without script.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the caption to sighted readers.

props.name: columns
props.type: { key: string; label: string; align?: "start" | "end"; primary?: boolean }[]
props.description: Columns; the first column's cells are row headers.

props.name: rows
props.description: Cell = string | number | null | undefined | { text, href?, badge?, tone?, mono?, sub?, current?, person?, avatar? }. `badge` is a registry badge variant (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link); `tone` is a status pill: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "info" | "accent" | "premium". `person` draws an avatar (the `avatar` URL, or initials) beside the name and `sub`.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Key whose text becomes each row's data-row, and the key `actions` is looked up by.

props.name: actions
props.type: Record<string, { label: string; href?: string; action?: string; method?: "post" | "get"; fields?: Record<string, string>; destructive?: boolean }[]>
props.description: Each row's actions, keyed by the row's `rowKey` text. An action is a link (`href`) or a form (`action`, POST unless `method` is "get", with hidden `fields`). One action is a button in the row; more are a <details> menu.

behaviour: Cell text is escaped: a row cannot inject markup.
An empty cell shows a dash to the eye and "none" to a screen reader.
A cell with `current` marks its row aria-current="true".

A cell with `tone` is a status pill (data-slot="status", data-tone) in a fixed status colour: success malachite, warning gold, info cobalt, accent terracotta, premium tanzanite, neutral muted. Its text is escaped like any cell's. `tone` wins over `badge`.
Filtering and paging are server-side (`@bundu/ui/lib/table`); pair with FilterBar or Toolbar and Pagination.

A cell with `person` is an avatar beside the name and, from `sub`, a secondary line (an email or a role). The avatar is the `avatar` image with alt="" (the name is beside it), or the person's initials, aria-hidden. With `href` the name is the link.

With `actions`, the table gains a last column headed "Actions" (visually hidden). A row with one action shows it as a small outline button whose accessible name ends with the row's name ("Change role: Tendai Moyo"); a row with more shows a <details> menu named "Actions for <row>", a list of links and buttons. A row with none has an empty cell.
An action with `href` is a link; any other is a <form> (POST unless `method` is "get") posting its hidden `fields`, with one submit button. Nothing needs script: the menu is a <details> disclosure.
A `destructive` action is drawn in the destructive colour and listed last; its label must say what it removes ("Remove member"), and it should lead to ConfirmAction rather than act at once.

status.description: Status pills in three tones, one with hostile text.

team.description: People with avatars or initials, and row actions: none, a menu of three, and one inline.

keyboard: Row actions: Tab to the menu's summary, Enter or Space opens it, then Tab through its links and buttons.
focus: Through cell links and row actions; `--ring` focus ring.
aria: Phone card labels are aria-hidden duplicates of the headers.
The Actions column header is visually hidden text.
An inline row action's name ends with the row's name; a menu is named "Actions for <row>".
An avatar image has alt="" and initials are aria-hidden: the name is written beside them.

density.select: details[data-slot="row-actions-menu"] li button, details[data-slot="row-actions-menu"] li a

theming.brandOverlay: Cell links are `--primary` and focus rings `--ring`. Rows and spacing are the same in every brand. Status pills (`tone`) are fixed status colours, the same in every brand; destructive actions use the destructive tokens in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Below md each row is a card and each cell shows its column name; from md it is a table with a header row and ~40px rows.
contract:
contract
  slot is "data-table"
  when default shows a "Tendai"
  uses badge
  when hostile slot is "data-table"
  when team shows summary "Actions for Rudo Chari"
  when team shows button "Resend invite"
end

checks.say: A captioned table.
Column headers are scoped.
Row headers are scoped.
An empty cell is spoken as none.
The current row is marked.
Cells cannot inject markup.
A tone cell is a status pill.
Every tone cell is a pill; tone wins over badge.
A tone cell with a badge renders no badge.
A status pill's text cannot inject markup.
Phone labels are hidden from screen readers.
A person cell is an avatar beside the name and the secondary line.
An avatar image is decorative: the name is beside it.
Without an image the avatar is the initials, hidden from screen readers.
Initials are up to two letters.
A person with href links the name.
The secondary line is shown once, inside the person.
Row actions add a visually hidden Actions column.
Every row has an actions cell, empty when it has none.
Several actions are a details menu named for the row.
